spanish: Y se levantó Bilam en la mañana, y dijo a príncipes de Balaq: Vayan a tierra de ustedes, porque rehusó Jehová darme andar con ustedes.
notes: Each token is represented: 3ms arose and said, 2mp imperative and suffixes as ustedes, singular land, piel refuse, YHWH as Jehová, and the 1cs suffix as the recipient of dar.
